subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should this PR require real QMD/GGUF embed proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate and accept the broader 600s default?
rationale: The change may be the right fix, but it changes upgrade behavior for existing unset QMD configs and the contributor has not shown the changed runtime behavior in a real QMD/GGUF embed path.

options.title: Require QMD proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, live output, or a linked artifact showing a real QMD/GGUF embed completing under the unset 600s default and update the docs before merge.

options.title: Override proof and accept the default
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the compatibility and CPU tradeoff without more contributor proof, then merge after the docs mismatch is addressed.

options.title: Narrow the strategy
options.body: Pause this PR and pursue selective local-GGUF behavior, warning-only guidance, or documentation if the broad default is too risky.

recommendation.title: Require QMD proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, live output, or a linked artifact showing a real QMD/GGUF embed completing under the unset 600s default and update the docs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to osolmaz, so they are the best available owner for the proof/default decision.
